claims.text: Lockheed Martin says it is investing $300 million in its Grand Prairie operation and expanding the manufacturing footprint to more than 735,000 square feet.
claims.quote: At the center of that growth is Lockheed Martin's Grand Prairie operation, where the company is investing $300 million and expanding its manufacturing footprint to more than 735,000 square feet.
claims.document: Lockheed Martin Expands Advanced Munitions Manufacturing in Texas, Driving Thousands of New American Jobs

claims.text: The expansion includes 100,000 square feet of new space and 85,000 square feet of office space being turned over to advanced manufacturing.
claims.quote: The expansion includes 100,000 square feet of new space and 85,000 square feet of office space being transformed for advanced manufacturing
claims.document: Lockheed Martin Expands Advanced Munitions Manufacturing in Texas, Driving Thousands of New American Jobs

claims.text: Hadrian will bring a highly automated machining cell to the Grand Prairie facility, and Lockheed Martin's own production workforce will operate it.
claims.quote: Hadrian will bring an innovative, highly automated machining cell to the Grand Prairie facility, operated by the world-class Lockheed Martin production workforce.
claims.document: Lockheed Martin Expands Advanced Munitions Manufacturing in Texas, Driving Thousands of New American Jobs

claims.text: The cell has 24 machines and is expected to be operational in early 2027.
claims.quote: Expected to be operational in early 2027, the 24-machine cell will bring commercial-style manufacturing technology directly into Lockheed Martin's production environment
claims.document: Lockheed Martin Expands Advanced Munitions Manufacturing in Texas, Driving Thousands of New American Jobs

claims.text: Lockheed Martin says it plans to create 6,000 jobs across the United States, 2,000 of them in Texas. These are the company's own figures.

claims.document: Lockheed Martin Expands Advanced Munitions Manufacturing in Texas, Driving Thousands of New American Jobs

rejected.finding: the PAC-3 page says where the missile is built
rejected.reason: The PAC-3 product page names no city, state or plant of manufacture. The release's Camden and Troy final assembly sites are carried as c8 from the release only.

rejected.finding: what AI does inside the Hadrian cell at Grand Prairie
rejected.reason: The release never says. AI appears only in Hadrian's description of its own factories (c15). Hadrian's pages describe Opus in general and never mention Lockheed, Grand Prairie or this cell.

rejected.finding: the cell is running or producing parts
rejected.reason: The release says only that it is expected to be operational in early 2027 (c4). The more than 30 machines producing components (c10) are Lockheed's own added machines, not the Hadrian cell.

rejected.finding: the Aviation Week MOU of December 8th, 2025 is the seven year agreement
rejected.reason: No fetched source equates them. The release says only that a seven year agreement was signed in 2025 (c13).

rejected.finding: the 2,000 Texas jobs are at Grand Prairie
rejected.reason: The release says 2,000 in Texas, not at Grand Prairie. Never subtract or compare with the nearly 800 production employees (c12).

rejected.finding: the TDLR filing documents the 2026 expansion
rejected.reason: It is a closed 2022 to 2024 renovation project. It establishes the address and Dallas County only (c34).
The release is datelined DALLAS and names Grand Prairie, never a county. Dallas County comes from the TDLR filing (c34).
A duplicate of c29 and only a listing, not the article.

rejected.finding: Under Secretary Michael P. Duffey's quote
rejected.reason: A quotation praising the expansion that adds no fact.
